mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_indictment (result_id, group_id, user_id, status, message) VALUES (#{resultId}, #{groupId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{message})
mapper.sql: FROM tbl_indictment i JOIN tbl_challenge_group g ON g.id = i.group_id JOIN tbl_group_challenge_daily_result r ON r.id = i.result_id

CASE WHEN g.eval_type = 'PERIOD' THEN COALESCE((SELECT GREATEST(SUM(rp.daily_amount - rp.verdict_deduction_amount), 0) FROM tbl_group_challenge_daily_result rp WHERE rp.group_id = g.id AND rp.user_id = i.user_id AND rp.challenge_date BETWEEN g.start_date AND g.end_date), 0) ELSE r.effective_amount END
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_group_member gm WHERE gm.group_id = i.group_id) - 1
mapper.select:
SELECT i.id AS indictment_id, g.id AS challenge_id, g.group_name AS challenge_name, AS amount, i.created_at AS created_at
WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.status = 'DEFENSE_WAIT' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tbl_defense d WHERE d.indictment_id = i.id) ORDER BY i.created_at, i.id

SELECT i.id AS indictment_id, g.id AS challenge_id, g.group_name AS challenge_name, AS defendant_nickname, AS amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_vote v WHERE v.indictment_id = i.id) AS vote_count, AS total_voters, i.created_at AS created_at
JOIN tbl_group_member m ON m.group_id = i.group_id AND m.user_id = #{userId} JOIN tbl_user u ON u.id = i.user_id WHERE i.status = 'VOTING' AND i.user_id <> #{userId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tbl_vote v WHERE v.indictment_id = i.id AND v.user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY i.created_at, i.id

SELECT i.id AS id, i.user_id AS user_id, AS nickname, u.profile_image_key AS profile_image_key, i.status AS status, r.challenge_date AS challenge_date, AS exceeded_amount, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tbl_defense d WHERE d.indictment_id = i.id) AS defended, (SELECT v.verdict FROM tbl_vote v WHERE v.indictment_id = i.id AND v.user_id = #{userId}) AS my_verdict, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_vote v WHERE v.indictment_id = i.id) AS vote_count, AS total_voters, i.created_at AS created_at
JOIN tbl_user u ON u.id = i.user_id WHERE i.group_id = #{groupId} AND i.status IN ('DEFENSE_WAIT', 'VOTING') ORDER BY i.created_at, i.id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_trials, COUNT(CASE WHEN i.status = 'GUILTY' THEN 1 END) AS guilty_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN i.status = 'INNOCENT' THEN 1 END) AS innocent_count FROM tbl_indictment i WHERE i.group_id = #{groupId} AND i.status IN ('GUILTY', 'INNOCENT')

SELECT i.id AS indictment_id, i.group_id AS group_id, g.group_name AS group_name, i.status AS status, i.result AS result, i.verdict_method AS verdict_method, i.ai_verdict_reason AS ai_verdict_reason, i.message AS message, i.user_id AS user_id, AS nickname, u.profile_image_key AS profile_image_key, g.eval_type AS eval_type, r.challenge_date AS challenge_date, g.start_date AS start_date, g.end_date AS end_date, g.category_id AS category_id, c.category_name AS category_name, g.limit_amount AS limit_amount, AS current_amount, AS exceeded_amount, (SELECT v.verdict FROM tbl_vote v WHERE v.indictment_id = i.id AND v.user_id = #{userId}) AS my_verdict, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_vote v WHERE v.indictment_id = i.id) AS vote_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_vote v WHERE v.indictment_id = i.id AND v.verdict = 'GUILTY') AS guilty_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_vote v WHERE v.indictment_id = i.id AND v.verdict = 'INNOCENT') AS innocent_count, AS total_voters, i.created_at AS created_at
JOIN tbl_group_member gm ON gm.group_id = i.group_id AND gm.user_id = #{userId} JOIN tbl_user u ON u.id = i.user_id LEFT JOIN tbl_category c ON c.id = g.category_id WHERE i.id = #{indictmentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_indictment SET status = 'VOTING' WHERE id = #{indictmentId} AND status = 'DEFENSE_WAIT'
UPDATE tbl_indictment SET status = 'GUILTY', result = 1, verdict_method = 'CONFESSION' WHERE id = #{indictmentId} AND status = 'DEFENSE_WAIT'
UPDATE tbl_indictment SET status = 'VOTING' WHERE status = 'DEFENSE_WAIT' AND created_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{defenseHours} HOUR)
mapper.select:
SELECT i.id AS indictment_id, i.group_id AS group_id, i.user_id AS user_id, i.result_id AS result_id, AS nickname, i.message AS message, g.eval_type AS eval_type, c.category_name AS category_name, g.limit_amount AS limit_amount, AS current_amount, AS exceeded_amount, d.content AS defense_content, d.actual_burden_amount AS actual_burden_amount, d.deduction_amount AS deduction_amount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_vote v WHERE v.indictment_id = i.id AND v.verdict = 'GUILTY') AS guilty_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_vote v WHERE v.indictment_id = i.id AND v.verdict = 'INNOCENT') AS innocent_count, AS total_voters
JOIN tbl_user u ON u.id = i.user_id LEFT JOIN tbl_category c ON c.id = g.category_id LEFT JOIN tbl_defense d ON d.indictment_id = i.id WHERE i.status = 'VOTING' AND ( i.created_at <= DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{defenseHours} HOUR), INTERVAL #{voteHours} HOUR) OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_vote v WHERE v.indictment_id = i.id) >= ) ORDER BY i.created_at, i.id
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_indictment SET status = #{status}, result = #{result}, verdict_method = #{verdictMethod}, ai_verdict_reason = #{aiVerdictReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE id = #{indictmentId} AND status = 'VOTING'
